description: Negative: two health:interpretationSourceCode values on one record
notes: The property is unconstrained in its VALUE by design, which makes it easy to assume it is unconstrained entirely. It is not: health:interpretation is 0..1, so the verbatim code that explains it is 0..1 too, and two source codes on one interpretation is a merge artefact. Measured RED against the pre-train spec pin, where the predicate had no shape.
